tool_args.rationale: The target horizon is 23.8, while all paid observations have H ≤ 0.48. A slow-horizon probe directly tests the proposed reversal and constrains the otherwise weakly identified slow dynamics.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit dual-horizon adaptation from the pilot alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five short-horizon rows cannot reliably identify the slow component or its long-horizon reversal.
Additional short-scale resolution is less informative about the target horizon and slow adaptation.

considered_alternatives.option: Lotka–Volterra harmonic and sink-coupled adaptation models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The short pilot does not adequately distinguish these alternatives from dual-horizon adaptation.
